info.title: Road Runners API
info.summary: Versioned API contracts for Road Runners integrations, game clients and MCP.
info.description: Road Runners API v1 exposes public and authorized current-user read models plus a restricted asynchronous result-submission contract for timing companies. Data endpoints require Authorization Bearer except the explicitly documented anonymous public calendar; portal cookies are never accepted. Authenticated responses expose RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset. Owner profile settings and visibility support explicit separately scoped writes with optimistic revision checks. Social links and verified Perfil.run preferences/custom links use separately scoped owner writes. Authenticated mobile activity feed and athlete profile/history reads. Owner profile photo read and scoped PNG upload.

get.description: Search current and future events. competition_id is an optional exact Foco Radical identifier, resolved through an active link to an active event. Existing date and search filters still apply. No match returns an empty list; the competition_id is not echoed in the response.

Search by a partial event name (q), full city name (city, case/accent insensitive) and state code (state), or filter by the exact Foco Radical competition_id. Existing date and result-availability filters still apply; no match returns an empty list. Each event includes stats.finishers and resultDistances for an event header when per-distance summaries exist. Participants can be requested using the same competition_id, without knowing a Road Runners identifier. The competition_id is not echoed in the response.

The same competition_id can be used for every page without knowing a Road Runners identifier. No active link to an active event returns 404. The result contains athlete, race and positions; pagination.total reflects the active filters. q matches part of the athlete name or an exact bib number. limit is capped at 100 and offset advances pages. Requires results:read_public. competition_id cannot be combined with a Road Runners identifier and is not echoed in the response.

HTTP(S) links only; results destination matches the website. registrationOpen is computed on the server with the website date/cancellation rules. post.summary: Update own name, profile address, location and bio
post.description: Requires explicit profile:write from new OAuth profile_write grant; existing profile grants stay read-only. Uses same owner resolution and JSON body only, maximum8192 UTF-8 bytes. Exactly six editable strings plus revision. Required name/tag/city; country two letters; Brazilian region empty or existing UF, other region free text. Server trims and applies the web name/city capitalization, lowercase accent-normalized tag and uppercase country/UF. API rejects overlength values and HTML delimiters instead of silently truncating; multiline bio is accepted. No account ID/email/roles/visibility/photo assignment. Optimistic revision and row locks prevent stale writes; conflict returns409 profile_changed, duplicate global tag returns409 tag_taken, missing/inactive owner404. Updates existing page/account atomically, keeping estado within its existing two-character limit and storing full regions in partner_info.location_region when available. Metadata region participates in the revision. If that optional existing column is absent and the region exceeds two characters, returns503 region_storage_unavailable without writes; never truncates or adds a column. Writes no cookies and creates no tables, columns or datasource. Clients must reconcile a lost response by GET; never blindly retry POST. Apache POST allowlist and fresh grant rollout are prerequisites, not deployed by this candidate.

get.summary: Read own Perfil.run appearance and contact settings
get.description: Owner identity from user/mobile Bearer only; configured official client for mobile. No cookies, URL parameters or client owner IDs. Requires mobileAuth enabled; no-store, private, max-age=0. Existing runner_dba tb_paginas/tb_usuarios only, no new schema. Preserves website verified-only edit permission, mandatory admin email contact and WhatsApp eligibility (nonblank public number). No email, phone or provider credentials returned. Requires me:read. Missing preference columns return web defaults dark/email-on/WhatsApp-off with editing disabled; missing cover column alone returns default Picsum893/1600/700 and disables cover editing only. GET projects admin email as true without the legacy page-load UPDATE. Capability flags are authoritative. Custom links are a separate contract.

get.summary: Read athlete profile header for an authenticated mobile viewer
get.description: Requires me:read and current mobile identity. Exact tag query only; no owner override. Minimal header matches the website: active athlete page name/photo/badges/location/bio and aggregate results/approved followers/following counts remain visible even for restricted profiles. Relations and permissions come from one SQL snapshot. canViewContent is true only for public profile, owner or approved type1 follower; pending requests do not qualify and no privileged bypass is added. The server must recheck access on every content request; this flag is not an authorization token. IDs are strings. No email, health fields, credentials, social-link secrets, result rows or history returned. Existing public profile endpoints remain unchanged. No writes, provider calls or schema changes. No-store. Public social links are returned only when profile access and each individual visibility flag allow them; provider credentials are never returned. Individual history is available separately at /athletes/mobile-feed.cfm. Follower lists and follow mutations are separate integrations outside this release.

post.summary: Save or remove a personal agenda event
post.description: agenda:write from new explicit OAuth agenda_write grant; old agenda grants remain read-only. No query parameters; JSON up to 2048 UTF-8 bytes, exactly two string fields. Owner always comes from the validated token. Requires active event starting after server time and enabled mobileAuth. save adds public inscricao; remove clears personal calendario/inscricao only, preserving supplier and operational checkins. No commercial registration/payment/cancellation. Existing tables, event row lock, transaction and unique constraint; repeated identical state does not create duplicates. Legacy web writes do not follow the same lock protocol; concurrency proof pending. No automatic POST retry; reload state on uncertainty. Does not invalidate existing web session caches.

post.summary: Follow, unfollow, approve or remove an own follower
post.description: User/mobile Bearer only, official mobile client, active own athlete page and active target, mobileAuth enabled. No cookies or client owner/page IDs. Existing runnerhub tables, no DDL. No-store/private/max-age=0. Only type1 relationships involving the authenticated owner; no third-party pending list. Private target is allowed because the relationship itself belongs to the viewer. Requires explicit connections_write grant mapped to connections:write. Exact three-field JSON <=1024 UTF-8 bytes; no query parameters. Follow public target accepted, private target pending; unfollow cancels either. Approve only own incoming pending; remove_follower removes own incoming pending/accepted. Never self-follow, including another page of the same owner. Stable ordered page/user locks and link-row locks; revision includes identities, target privacy, relation status and creation timestamp, then compare before mutation. Existing unique key prevents duplicate insert. Only a newly inserted follow triggers best-effort central notification after commit; no automatic delivery/write retry and no new queue. Legacy web has no CAS and independent session caches; unchanged here. On409 or uncertain outcome GET then another explicit action. Narrow Apache POST exception included. Real concurrent writes and notification delivery still require homologation.

BearerAuth.description: Integration or user Bearer token. Required for data endpoints except the explicitly anonymous public calendar; never send tokens in query strings or cookies.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated identifier for one logical submission version. Persist it before the first attempt and reuse the same key with the exact same JSON after timeouts or lost responses. A retry returns the existing submission without duplication; reusing the key with different content returns 409. Use a new key for final publication or a later update. The key is scoped to clientId and is not a secret.

FocoCompetitionId.name: competition_id
FocoCompetitionId.description: Exact Foco Radical competition identifier. Optional alternative to Road Runners event identifiers; do not combine with id, eventId, event_id, id_evento, tag, eventTag or event_tag. Only active links to active events are used. Treat as a string and preserve leading zeros. Empty values, control characters or more than 255 characters return 400 invalid_competition_id; conflicting identifiers return 400 conflicting_event_identifiers. This input is not echoed in JSON responses.

ResultsEventIdOptional.description: Road Runners event id; alternative to tag and id.

EventNameQuery.description: Partial event name; the search also checks event tags and related text.

ResultParticipantQuery.description: Part of the participant's name or an exact bib number.

links.description: Links públicos em ordem Strava, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, site, loja e WhatsApp. Perfil público, proprietário ou seguidor aprovado e visibilidade individual obrigatórios. canChange.description: Active event starts after the server current time. Every POST rechecks this condition.
